title: 1. Purpose
text:
This document explains how Lyngpakke AS calculates the price of a parcel sent within Norway. It is
the main reference for the Pricing team, customer service and the developers of the pricing engine.
Detailed rates are kept in the Weight and Size Price Table, and zone rules are kept in the Postal Zone
Rules.

title: 2. Price components
text:
Every parcel price is built from the following components.
• Base price: set by the chargeable weight band in the Weight and Size Price Table.
• Agreement discount: a percentage that applies to the base price only, for business customers
with an annual agreement.
• Zone multiplier: set by the delivery zone, from 1.00 for Zone A to 1.60 for Zone D.
• Fixed fees: home delivery of 49 NOK and the oversize surcharge of 150 NOK, when they apply.
• Fuel surcharge: 12.5 percent of the subtotal, from 1 January 2026.

title: 2.1 Chargeable weight
text:
The chargeable weight is the higher of the actual weight and the volumetric weight. Volumetric
weight in kilograms is length times width times height in centimetres, divided by 5,000. Light but
bulky parcels are therefore priced by the space they take up.

title: 3. Calculation order
text:
The pricing engine must apply the components in this order. Changing the order changes the result,
so the order is part of the pricing rules.
1. Find the chargeable weight and look up the base price for its weight band.
2. Apply the agreement discount to the base price.
3. Multiply by the zone multiplier.
4. Add fixed fees such as home delivery and oversize.
5. Add the fuel surcharge as a percentage of the subtotal.
6. Round the final price to the nearest 0.50 NOK.

title: 4. Rounding
text:
Rounding happens once, at the end of the calculation. Intermediate results keep full precision. The
final price is rounded to the nearest 0.50 NOK, and a value exactly halfway between two steps is
rounded up.

title: 5. Ownership and changes
text:
The Pricing team owns all prices and rules. Rates are changed through the Master Data Admin
portal, following the Admin Guide. Prices change twice a year at most, on 1 January and 1 July, and
every change is listed in the Pricing Change Log.

title: 6. Worked example
text:
A business customer with a 10 percent agreement discount sends a parcel weighing 4 kg and
measuring 40 by 30 by 30 cm. It goes from postal code 0150 to postal code 5020 with home delivery.

title: 7. Out of scope
text:
This model does not cover parcels over 35 kg, which are handled as freight, or parcels sent outside
Norway.

title: 1. Base prices by weight band
text:
Base prices are in NOK, excluding VAT, and apply to the chargeable weight as defined in the Pricing Model Overview. The lower limit of each band is exclusive and the upper limit is inclusive.
Weight band | Base price | Typical parcel
0–1 kg | 89 NOK | Documents, small accessories
Over 1–5 kg | 129 NOK | Shoes, books
Over 5–10 kg | 179 NOK | Small appliances
Over 10–20 kg | 249 NOK | Computer equipment
Over 20–35 kg | 349 NOK | Furniture parts
Parcels with a chargeable weight over 35 kg are not accepted as parcels. They must be booked as freight.

title: 2. Zone multipliers
text:
Zone | Multiplier | Description
A | 1.00 | Central region
B | 1.15 | Regional cities
C | 1.35 | Rural areas
D | 1.60 | Remote areas and islands

title: 3. Size limits
text:
Maximum length of the longest side: 150 cm.
Maximum length plus girth: 300 cm. Girth is two times the width plus two times the height.
Parcels over these limits are not accepted as parcels.

title: 4. Fixed fees
text:
Fee | Amount | When it applies
Home delivery | 49 NOK | Delivery to the door instead of a pickup point
Oversize surcharge | 150 NOK | The longest side is over 120 cm
Scheduled pickup | 250 NOK | Per pickup. See Annual Business Agreements for when it is waived

title: Rule Z-1. Zones by postal code
Rule Z-2. Island exceptions
text:
Some postal codes are on islands without a road connection, even though their number falls in Zone
B or C. These postal codes are always priced as Zone D: 4985, 4986, 6995 and 7994. This exception
overrides Rule Z-1.

title: Rule Z-3. Sender and receiver in different zones
text:
The zone is found for both the sender postal code and the receiver postal code. When they differ,
the higher zone applies. For example, a parcel from Zone A to Zone C is priced as Zone C.

title: Rule Z-4. Pickup point and home delivery
text:
Zone multipliers apply to both pickup point delivery and home delivery. Home delivery also adds the
fixed home delivery fee of 49 NOK. The fee is not affected by the zone multiplier, because fixed fees
are added after the multiplier.

title: Rule Z-5. When zone changes take effect
text:
Changes to zones or to the list of island exceptions only take effect on 1 January or 1 July. A change
agreed on any other date waits until the next of these dates.

title: Rule Z-6. Unknown postal codes
text:
If a postal code cannot be found, the booking is rejected with an error. The engine must never guess
a zone.

title: 1. Who this applies to
text: Business customers who expect to send at least 1,000 parcels a year can sign an annual agreement. The agreement gives a fixed discount on the base price for 12 months.

title: 2. Volume discount tiers
text:
Expected parcels per year | Discount on base price | Approval
1,000–4,999 | 5 percent | Account manager
5,000–19,999 | 10 percent | Account manager
20,000 or more | 15 percent | Pricing team
A discount above 15 percent is only possible as a special agreement and must be approved by the Head of Pricing.

title: 3. What the discount covers
text: The discount applies to the base price only. It does not reduce the zone multiplier, fixed fees or the fuel surcharge.

title: 4. Scheduled pickups
text: Customers with an agreement can book scheduled pickups for a fee of 250 NOK per pickup. The fee is waived when a pickup has more than 50 parcels.

title: 5. Volume follow-up
text: Actual volumes are checked every quarter. If a customer stays below its tier for two quarters in a row, it moves down to the tier that matches its actual volume from the start of the next quarter. Customers are told in writing at least 30 days before the change.

title: 6. Renewal
text: Agreements last 12 months. The account manager starts a renewal review 60 days before the end date. An agreement that is not renewed ends, and the customer pays standard prices from the day after the end date.

title: 1. Roles
text:
Role | Can do
Pricing Viewer | Read all price tables and the audit log
Pricing Admin | Create drafts, review other admins’ drafts and publish

title: 2. Changing a price
text:
Sign in to the Master Data Admin portal and open the table you want to change, for example Weight Bands.
Select Create draft. The draft is a copy of the current version.
Change the values and enter the reason for the change.
Set the effective date. It must be 1 January or 1 July, and it cannot be in the past.
Submit the draft for review.
A second Pricing Admin reviews and approves it. You cannot approve your own draft.
After approval, select Publish. The new version takes effect on the effective date.

title: 3. Rules
text:
Every change needs two people: one to create it and one to approve it.
Prices cannot be backdated.
Every change is recorded in the audit log, which is kept for 5 years.

title: 4. Undoing a change
text: Published versions cannot be edited. To undo a change, open the previous version in the history, create a draft from it and follow the same review and publish steps.

title: 5. Getting help
text: For access problems, contact the Pricing team lead. For errors in the portal, raise a support case with the pricing engine team.

title: Version 2026.1, effective 1 January 2026
text:
Fuel surcharge raised from 11 percent to 12.5 percent.
Base price for 0–1 kg raised from 85 NOK to 89 NOK.

title: Version 2025.2, effective 1 July 2025
text:
Zone D multiplier raised from 1.50 to 1.60.
Oversize surcharge of 150 NOK introduced for parcels whose longest side is over 120 cm.
Postal code 7994 added to the island exceptions in Rule Z-2.

title: Version 2025.1, effective 1 January 2025
text:
Home delivery fee raised from 39 NOK to 49 NOK.
Volume discount for 20,000 or more parcels raised from 12 percent to 15 percent.
